lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice simple hypothetical wishes with om jag hade tid, skulle jag.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A relaxed fika conversation about what someone would do with more free time.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Talking about imagined but simple possibilities.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about hobbies, rest, or travel they would choose if they had more time or energy.

main_focus.name: simple second conditional with skulle
main_focus.description: Use om plus past tense and skulle plus infinitive for a simple hypothetical situation.
model_examples: Om jag hade mer tid, skulle jag träna oftare.
Om jag var ledig, skulle jag åka till havet.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use simple om plus skulle structures naturally 2-3 times in the dialogue.

avoid_grammar: complex unreal past with skulle ha

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Keep hypotheticals about ordinary wishes and free-time activities.

dialogue_shape.opening: One person asks what the other would do with more time or a free day.
dialogue_shape.middle: They share two simple imagined choices with reasons.
dialogue_shape.ending: They connect the imagined idea back to a realistic plan.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat simple second conditional without expanding into advanced forms

focus: which activity is preferred in that situation
how the imagined idea connects to a real plan

sentence_focus: one sentence with om jag hade mer tid
one sentence with då skulle jag
one sentence with om jag var ledig
one sentence giving a reason for a hypothetical choice
one sentence connecting a wish to a realistic plan
